title: Grade owns, applied_at, and rule markers in knowledge check
action: Per D4: add six finding codes to check.rs:279 `check_bundle`, graded as profile ERRORS in the default run (not warnings; the plan names why). Codes and their rule: `dangling_applied_at` and `dangling_owns` — a listed path (trailing-`*` glob allowed) that resolves to nothing, resolved bundle-first then repo-root exactly like check.rs:543-570 `dangling_required_context`; with no repo root, out-of-bundle targets are skipped and the report carries a one-line note. `duplicate_rule_home` — the same `<!-- rule: <id> -->` opening marker in two files. `unknown_rule_ref` — a `(rule: <id>)` reference whose id no marker opens. `applied_at_unlinked` — a file listed in some concept's applied_at that contains no `(rule: <id>)` for any rule that concept homes. `owns_missing` — an area `overview.md` (a bee.area concept at areas/<area>/overview.md) carrying none of the owns.* keys; this is a separate walk over area overviews, never an entry in frame.rs:164 PROFILE_REQUIRED. The marker/reference scan reads the bundle plus AGENTS.md and skills/**, and skips docs/history/, docs/discovery/, docs/specs/, .bee/. Reuse the report shape of the existing dangling_* findings (path, code, message). Update the `knowledge check` help text in src/generated/registry_payload.json (rg -n 'knowledge' there) and any catalog count in src/catalog.rs the registry drift test pins (see the precedent note near catalog.rs:328). Sync docs/knowledge/areas/okf-profile/conformance-check.md with the six codes and their grade — the spec is this check's home. Tests: one case per code plus the exempt-tree and no-repo-root cases; cite tests.rs:1242 `dangling_required_context_warns_only_for_the_unresolvable_target` as the fixture pattern.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee knowledge && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts
